0022600107.text: The Rockets (2-0, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) make their third game of the season a trip to the Hawks (2-0, 1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East), with both teams unbeaten so far. Houston is 1-0 on the road, while Atlanta is 2-0 away from home and has yet to play a home game this season, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. Houston won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026, and Reed Sheppard is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision for the Rockets, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both out.
